title: FR: embedded_io support
author: Conaclos
body_preview: `serde_json` supports `no_std` environment. Unfortunately `core` doesn't include any `io` implementations. It could be nice if serde_json added support for [`embeded_io`](https://github.com/rust-embedded/embedded-hal/tree/master/embedded-io) that seems to be the de facto standard for `no_std`.
